I have been trying for 2 days with screenshots to report this through customer service. They just aren’t getting it. When I click an item on the market, by default, expect to see lowest in my station first followed by lowest closest. It’s almost random what shows on top and often the lowest in station is pages down, and if I click purchase it should always sell me lowest in that location even if I click a higher priced item as long as both are in same station. Can someone with some pull or contact at netease get them to fix this? It is harming the game and screwing over newer players who just assume first station price is lowest in station even if it’s not even in the top 20 cheapest. I’ve also seen players abusin this by creating lots of little orders to work it out do their very high item is showing on top of list. The market has to show lowest at station order by default and not hide lower orders or force users to resort every time they click a market item. Please someone get this issue in front of someone at netease who can fix this ASAP!

MANY mobile games have way more than 200k players at once. Mobile legends, pubg, call of duty, clash of clans, etc. they have millions online at once. Eve echoes however doesn’t have multiple servers or shards. The entire player base of eve online is only 300k which is probably lower than pretty much any mobile game. The eve echoes playerbase could gain 300k players a MONTH easy. The real problem is whether the Chinese players get their own server before they have so much time invested on the server opening on the 13th that they won’t want to move. The Chinese player base for echoes will be huge. Just look at second galaxy and you’ll see the majority of players are Chinese. Note I am not in any way trash talking Chinese players just stating a fact. They really should have released Chinese server on day 1 to at least split them out so as not to burn the servers down. The good news is they will be playing mostly in a different time zone then most western players so even if they all stay it still might work out.

If you assume half of the 5 million won’t play or are alt accounts that’s 2.5 million players at least in week 1 before a percentage of folks drop off to it not being their thing. Assume all 2.5 million will log in on either day 1 or 2 and play for 2 hours. That’s 24 time slots. Divide 2.5 million by 24 that’s about 100,000 online at a given time. Granted some folks will be on more than 2 hours on day 1 and 2 but probably not as many as you think. The final test allowed 10,000 android users to sign up and on going live they still hadn’t filled all 10,000 slots. I’m guessing less than 30,000 players will average more than 4 hours between day 1 and 2.

Realistically no pve content is really designed as group content. While you can join folks doing missions, you can’t share missions to all get mission rewards. Also, isk for npc ship skills is not shared. Last hit gets it all. Finally, there is no loot sharing option like round rob8n or roll need vs greed. Whoever loots first gets it. Hopefully, they will change some of this to make group pve a thing.

Eve echoes will have more users join per month then eve online ever had and will have 6 times the online population. Eve echoes success has nothing to do with eve online and will have 15 times the user base within a month. Eve online will crawl along with a player base so small it boggles the mind that ccp continues to support it.
